ValidationRule.description: Ensures that the resource requirement this job offer points to, if exists, belongs to the same job that this offer points to.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK( sked__Resource_Requirement__c ) ) , NOT( ISPICKVAL( sked__Resource_Requirement__r.sked__Job_Status__c , 'Cancelled') ) , NOT( ISPICKVAL( sked__Job__r.sked__Job_Status__c , 'Cancelled') ) , sked__Resource_Requirement__r.sked__Job__c <> sked__Job__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Resource requirement, if specified, must belong to the same job.
